turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's start with why my son's mark went to a zero before anyone called me.
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
Okay. So the procedure was skipped, and Owen found out from his phone in the middle of class. What do you have that says this essay isn't his?
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.

You say that line "isn't anywhere in Hamlet." Show me the page it's on, and show me where the essay says it comes from the play. A wrong quotation is a wrong quotation, and I'll want to see what else you have.
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.
You'll want to be very careful about the next sentence, Hale. "It seems to run in the family" is going in my notes word for word, and the principal will read it. Now, the page with that line on it.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn on Owen's essay, an apology to Owen, and the page showing the line you raised. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed beyond your admission that the zero was entered before you called.
What moved her: nothing.
